Hi Jane / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps to get the PR on your side and link our supplier ID in Coupa/Ariba so billing flows cleanly.

Recap

- Procurement items: vendor setup, W-9 (or local equivalent), vendor questionnaire, supplier ID linkage in Coupa.
- Commercial: initial commitment will be a 12-month reserved capacity pilot (deal ACME-2026-047).

3) If you can create a supplier record in Coupa and share the supplier ID, we can reference that in our invoices. Alternately, we can provide the required vendor docs and your team can create the supplier on our behalf.
4) We'll open an internal ticket to link the supplier ID to our billing system and to ensure invoices route properly to the right contact.

I attached a short PR template and our supplier setup guidance for Coupa/Ariba to speed things up. If helpful, we can do a 15-min screen share with your procurement admin to walk through the supplier creation flow.

Suggested timeline: Supplier docs + supplier ID by end of next week (2026-11-20) so finance can issue the initial PO.

Thanks — looping in Aditya (AE) for pricing/terms details and Rafael (SE) if you want a quick technical kickoff.
